name: sage-desktop-companion
description: SAGE — a local-first desktop AI companion.

scripts.check: node --check app/main.mjs && node --check app/preload.mjs && node --check app/core/runtime.mjs && node --check app/core/memory.mjs && node --check app/core/policy.mjs && node --check app/core/assistant.mjs && node --check app/core/model.mjs && node --check app/core/reminders.mjs && node --check app/core/experience.mjs && node --check app/core/proactive.mjs && node --check app/core/voice.mjs && node --check app/core/plugin.mjs && node --check app/core/context.mjs && node --check app/renderer/app.mjs && npm test
scripts.validate:package: node -e "const p=require('./package.json'); if(p.private!==true) throw new Error('SAGE must remain private until release'); if(p.type!=='module') throw new Error('SAGE must use ESM'); if(p.main!=='app/main.mjs') throw new Error('Unexpected Electron entry point'); if(p.engines?.node!=='>=22') throw new Error('Node 22+ is required'); if(p.devDependencies?.electron!=='42.11.2') throw new Error('Unexpected Electron version'); if(p.devDependencies?.['electron-builder']!=='26.15.3') throw new Error('Unexpected electron-builder version'); console.log('package metadata OK')"
